scholarships.name: COMPEX Scholarship Scheme (Embassy of India, Bachelor in India)
scholarships.covers: Full tuition, hostel fee and monthly living allowance at Indian universities for BE/BTech, BPharm, BSc Agriculture, BSc Dairy Technology, BSc Food Technology and BSc Nursing
scholarships.who: Nepali +2 Science graduates (with Physics, Chemistry and Maths/Biology, minimum 60% overall and 50% in English)
scholarships.how: Apply online when the Embassy of India Kathmandu publishes the annual COMPEX notice in April or May, and sit the computer-based exam

scholarships.name: Silver Jubilee Scholarship Scheme (SJSS, Master and PhD in India)
scholarships.covers: Full tuition waiver, monthly stipend, hostel/contingent grant for MBA, MCA, MSc, MA and PhD (except medical courses) at premier Indian universities
scholarships.who: Nepali bachelor or master graduates with strong academic records and 60%+ in English
scholarships.how: Apply directly on the ICCR A2A portal (a2ascholarships.iccr.gov.in) in February-March and submit the counterfoil directly at the Embassy in Kathmandu or Consulate in Birgunj

scholarships.name: AYUSH Scholarship Scheme (Traditional Medicine in India)
scholarships.by: Ministry of AYUSH and ICCR, Government of India
scholarships.covers: Full tuition, monthly stipend and accommodation for BAMS (Ayurveda), BHMS (Homeopathy), BUMS (Unani), MD Ayurveda and PhD in India
scholarships.who: Nepali students with +2 Science (PCB) for undergraduate or BAMS/BHMS for postgraduate study
scholarships.how: Apply online through the ICCR A2A portal during the May-June application window

scholarships.name: Homi Jahangir Bhabha Scholarship Scheme (ME / MTech in India)
scholarships.covers: Full tuition and monthly stipend for a two-year ME or MTech degree at leading Indian engineering institutes
scholarships.who: Nepali BE or BTech graduates meeting the Embassy's academic and age criteria
scholarships.how: Apply online via the Embassy of India Kathmandu notice published around February-March

scholarships.name: Project for Human Resource Development Scholarship (JDS, Japan)
scholarships.covers: Full university tuition, monthly living allowance in Japan, return airfare and research allowances
scholarships.who: Permanent civil service officers of the Government of Nepal in target policy and infrastructure tracks
scholarships.how: Apply through the JDS Nepal project office and Ministry of Finance / MoFAGA nomination cycle

scholarships.name: KOICA CIAT Master's and PhD Fellowship (South Korea)
scholarships.covers: Full tuition, dormitory accommodation, monthly living allowance, round-trip airfare and settlement grant in South Korea
scholarships.who: Government officials, public enterprise staff and public institute researchers nominated by the Government of Nepal
scholarships.how: Apply through your ministry and the Ministry of Finance when KOICA Nepal announces the annual CIAT call

scholarships.name: UGC Nepal Need, Formula and Girls Scholarships at Community Campuses
scholarships.by: University Grants Commission (UGC) Nepal and QAA Community Campuses
scholarships.covers: Full or partial tuition waivers and annual stipends for economically disadvantaged, Dalit, Janajati, remote-district, martyr-family and female students
scholarships.who: Students enrolled in UGC-supported and QAA-accredited community campuses across Nepal
scholarships.how: Apply at your campus administration with a local ward recommendation and SEE/+2 transcripts after admission

abroad.work: Up to 20 hours/week during semester and full-time in June-August; 3-year job-seeking stay after a degree
abroad.note: Check official SIRI (nyidanmark.dk) rules on Accompanying Family and accredited state universities before applying.

exams: IELTS or TOEFL for English courses
abroad.work: Up to 20 hours/week with an AMS work permit; 12-month Red-White-Red card job search after graduation
abroad.note: Public universities like TU Wien, University of Vienna and JKU Linz charge around EUR 726.72 per semester. Documents require verification.

abroad.work: Full-time or part-time work permitted for full-time degree students with a valid residence permit
abroad.note: Affordable Schengen tuition at public technical universities (Warsaw, AGH Krakow, Wroclaw). Verify NAWA recognition.

abroad.work: Up to 30 hours/week allowed on a higher-education student permit compatible with classes
abroad.note: Public universities in Catalonia, Madrid and Andalusia charge modest credit fees compared to private business schools.
